item.description:
🎉Welcome to GoldStar Official Store🎉
✅All the product is ready stock!
🚚Delivered within 2-3 working days.
📦Double check before ship,100% secure packaging

➫Specifications
🔥Yowxii Strong Iron🔥
●Product Name: Strong Handheld Steam Iron.
●Product size :170*150*80mm.
●Rated Voltage :220V.
●Rated power :1200W.
●Steam capacity :20g/min.
●Tank volume :200ml.3●Function:Detachable,Portable,Foldable.
●Packing list:
1 X Main Machine.
1 X Water Tank.
1 X Manual.


➫Use Method
1. Assemble the machine.
2. Fill water into the machine tank: minimum 1/3 of the tank capacity.
3. Plug in the Power,then Press the Button and the red indicator light is on.
4. Wait for around 30 seconds, the water steam come out
5. You can start to iron your clothes now!
 

➫Note
◆The product needs to be preheated before working (after plugging in the power supply, the indicator light will be on, wait for about 30 seconds, and then start the switch to start working after the indicator light is off)
◆Do not leave the product while it is powered on.
◆Do not spray steam on people or animals to avoid burns.
◆Please do not let children, people without independent behavior or lack of relevant experience use this product alone to avoid danger.
◆Unplug the power cord when servicing, cleaning or cleaning.
◆Do not add hot water to the water tank to avoid deformation.
◆Do not add other solutions to the tank.
◆When using the appliance, take care to prevent splashing of steam.
◆After use, please prevent scalding when turning the remaining hot water in the tank upside down.
▶After use, please allow the product to cool naturally.
